meta.homeDescription: Open-source legal workspace for documents, matters, contract review, and case-law research. Self-host or use our cloud. Usage-based AI, no vendor lock-in.
nav.products.agent.blurb: Chat with your matters, documents, registries, and connected tools in one place. The AI agent acts with approvals and source previews, grounds its answers in citations, and extends through skills and external connectors.
nav.products.agent.title: An AI agent that works across your matters, files, and tools.
nav.products.anonymization.blurb: Remove names, entities, and identifying details before material reaches AI, directly from chat and document review, with a redacted result you can check before anything moves on.
nav.products.anonymization.title: Prepare material for AI without exposing identifying details.
nav.products.cli-mcp.blurb: Search, read, and work with stella from the command line or any MCP-compatible client. Both surfaces share the same capability registry, permissions, and workspace data.
nav.products.cli-mcp.title: One workspace, from every tool.
nav.products.editor.blurb: Open and edit Word .docx files right in your browser: no install, no converting to another format. stella's online DOCX editor preserves the original formatting and track changes, keeps the file connected to its matter, and saves each revision into the document's version history.
nav.products.editor.title: Edit Word documents in the browser, without leaving the matter.
nav.products.public-data.blurb: Case law and company registries from official public sources, collected by stella's Legal Atlas with their structure preserved. Read a decision, look up a company, follow citations, and reference any of it from a matter or hand it to the AI agent.
nav.products.public-data.title: Legal data, ready for your work.
nav.products.tabular-review.blurb: Ask questions across a whole document set and get structured answers back as a table in the matter — sortable, filterable, and traceable to the source text. Built for due diligence, discovery, and research.
nav.products.tabular-review.title: Turn a pile of documents into a table you can review.
nav.products.templates.blurb: Define a template once with fields and conditional clauses, then fill it in by hand or let stella draft it from a matter's data. The finished document lands in the matter, ready to keep editing.
nav.products.templates.title: Build reusable templates, and let AI fill them in.
nav.products.workspace.blurb: The workspace holds a matter's documents, Word .docx editing, review, research, and chat in one place, so the work stays in context from source material to answer.
nav.products.workspace.title: Matters, documents, review, and chat in one workspace.

products.editor.faqs.0.answer: Yes. The document is edited where it lives, alongside the matter's other files, properties, tasks, and conversations, so no local copy is downloaded and re-uploaded to make a change.
products.editor.faqs.0.question: Does the document stay attached to its matter while I edit?
products.editor.faqs.1.answer: Yes. Tracked insertions and deletions appear in place, the way Word shows them. Edits proposed by stella's AI arrive the same way, so a redline is reviewed and accepted or rejected before it becomes part of the document.
products.editor.faqs.1.question: Does the editor keep track changes?
products.editor.faqs.2.answer: The saved file remains connected to the same matter and document, and the save becomes a revision in that document's version history.
products.editor.faqs.2.question: What happens when I save?
products.editor.faqs.3.answer: Yes. Saved revisions stay in the document's version history, so the current file and the ones it replaced remain together on the same document.
products.editor.faqs.3.question: Can I get back to an earlier revision?
products.editor.faqs.4.answer: Yes. The stella desktop bridge opens the document in local Office for Word-specific workflows and returns the edited file to the same matter.
products.editor.faqs.4.question: Can I open the same document in Microsoft Word?
products.editor.faqs.5.answer: Yes. The document is part of its matter, so the AI agent can read it and propose edits as tracked changes in the same document.
products.editor.faqs.5.question: Can stella's AI work on the document I am editing?

products.workspace.faqs.0.answer: Yes. The web app supports Word .docx editing and review. For local Office editing, the desktop app acts as a bridge so you can open a document from stella and edit it on your computer.
products.workspace.faqs.0.question: Can I edit Word documents in stella?
products.workspace.faqs.1.answer: Documents, contacts, review tables, chat threads, and document history. Everything added to a matter stays attached to it, so the context is there when you return.
products.workspace.faqs.1.question: What lives inside a matter?
products.workspace.faqs.2.answer: Yes. The stella CLI and MCP server expose the same matters, documents, and case law to connected tools, under the same permissions. See CLI & MCP for details.
products.workspace.faqs.2.question: Can other tools reach the workspace?
products.workspace.metaDescription: Matters, documents, Word .docx editing, review, research, and chat in one legal workspace. The work stays in context from source material to answer.
products.workspace.quickAnswer.answer: A web app that holds matters, documents, Word .docx editing, review, research, and chat in one place. Everything added to a matter stays attached to it, so the context is there when you return. A companion desktop app acts as a local bridge when a document needs Microsoft Word.

story.agentBody: The AI agent searches the matter, reads the relevant text, and answers with citations that open the source at the exact passage. Use it in stella, or connect it to the tools you already work in.
story.agentTitle: Ask once. Every answer cites its source.
story.controlBody: stella is <gh>open-source</gh> legal software you can self-host: inspect the code, run it your way, and export everything in standard formats.
story.dataBody: Read Czech case law with AI issue notes, highlights, underlines, lawyer comments and cited answers. Look up companies in connected official registries and reference the sources from a matter.

story.dataTitle: Bring the law and the data with you.
story.intro: Source material, review, and final documents stay in the matter and build on each other. Work on the matter with the AI agent, and verify every step it takes.
story.proofByokBody: Use your own provider keys for AI features.
story.proofOpenSourceBody: Inspect the code and keep a portable system.
story.proofPermissionsBody: Every action stays within the user's and the workspace's permissions.
story.proofSelfHostBody: Run stella on infrastructure you control.
story.title: One matter. Every part of the work.
